reason: I already pay a setter who works my inbox, and I've read a hundred AI-written DMs that sound like AI. Prospects can tell. There's not one customer result on the page, so I'd be the guinea pig with a card on file and a 3-day window that's too short to see a single booked call.
objection: AI-written DMs sound robotic and prospects can tell, and nobody has shown me it books calls. A 3-day trial can't prove that when replies take days, and 'payments are final' after day 4 means I'm risking my Instagram account and $147 on a promise.
would_change_my_mind: Real results from agency owners like me (replies and booked calls from actual sent DMs, with sample DMs I can read), plus a longer trial or a refund window long enough to run a week of outreach.
